description: The last 50 writes the list's write rules refused, newest first: when, which operation, which identity and token, the stage (allow: no rule authorised it, 403; require: a check failed, 400), and the statement and line that refused it. A refusal can take a moment to appear. Replay one with test_list_rules to see why. The token needs update on the list. 1 request.
